lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Meridian, you're through. Anchor reads stable. Local reactor is live and has been live for eleven years.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Eleven years of somebody's power bill and nobody home. That bothers me more than the wardens do.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Bother me about it after. Sixty megawatts, that's the whole budget?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: That's the whole budget. Build what you can run, not what you can afford.
lines.beat: teaches the hook without saying the word tutorial

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact. Ordinal constructs, low threat profile. They're not coming for you — they're coming for the ring.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: They don't flank. They don't stop. What are these things for?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Containment. They're executing an order. I'd like to know what it was about.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Bus is over. Everything you own just got slower — pick something and cut it.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through. Ring integrity holding. Don't make a habit of it.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Anchor's ours. Okonkwo, the containment order — can you read it?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Some of it. It names a thing, and then it names sixty other anchors. This one is number four.
lines.beat: the campaign's actual premise, delivered flatly
